description: HTML source code for a web-based database viewer interface, including styles, structure, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic interactions with a backend API to browse databases, tables, and view data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from backend API and populates the sidebar menu.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by calling loadDatabases and updating UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles display of tables for a selected database, fetching tables if necessary.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data from a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML table from data rows and inserts into container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates a table cell HTML based on data type, handles long objects and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for verbose or object data types.
